note: Public problem statements given to ReproLab as input. No answers, locations or oracles here.

cases.title: Discount disappears after checkout reload
cases.bug_report: I applied the coupon SAVE10 at checkout and the discount showed up, but when I refreshed the checkout page the discount was gone and I was back to paying full price.

cases.title: Cart subtotal does not update with quantity
cases.bug_report: On the cart page, when I press + to change how many of an item I want, the quantity goes up but the subtotal at the bottom stays at the old amount.

cases.title: Category filter lost on page 2
cases.bug_report: In the shop I filtered by the Kitchen category, then went to page 2 of the results. Page 2 shows products from every category and the filter seems to have been dropped.
